title: Strawberry banana smoothie
intro: Ripe banana sweetens the strawberries; yogurt makes it creamy.

steps.t: Rinse the strawberries, hull them and cut them in half.
Peel the banana and slice it into rounds.
Put the fruit, yogurt, milk and ice in the blender.
Blend on high for 1 minute, until smooth and frothy.
Pour into two tall glasses right away and serve cold.

tips.t: Add 2 tbsp rolled oats and it becomes a full breakfast.
Freeze the halved strawberries and skip the ice: it stays thicker.

title: Green kiwi and spinach smoothie
intro: Kiwi and green apple hide the spinach: fresh and tangy with a hint of ginger.

steps.t: Peel the kiwis and banana. Core the apple and chop it, skin on.
Scrape the ginger peel off with a teaspoon and slice it thinly.
Put water and spinach in the blender first, then fruit, ginger, lemon and ice.
Blend on high for 60–90 seconds, until no green flecks remain.
If it's too thick, add a splash of water. Serve right away.

tips.t: Blend the spinach and water alone for 20 seconds first: no stringy bits.
Out of kiwi season, use pineapple instead.

title: Mango lassi
intro: Ripe mango and yogurt with a pinch of cardamom, the way Indian stalls make it.

steps.t: Peel the mango, cut the flesh away from the stone and chop it.
Blend mango, yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom for 1 minute, until velvety.
Taste it: if the mango isn't very sweet, add a little more sugar.
Add the ice, blend 10 more seconds and pour, dusting with a little cardamom.

tips.t: 150 g canned mango pulp works well all year round.
A few saffron threads soaked in a spoonful of milk make it festive.

title: Peanut butter banana shake
intro: Thick as a milkshake thanks to frozen banana, no ice cream needed.

steps.t: Pour the milk into the blender, then add the frozen banana.
Add the peanut butter, cocoa, maple syrup and a pinch of salt.
Blend on high for 1 minute, until thick and smooth like a milkshake.
If it's too thick, add milk a spoonful at a time. Serve with a straw.

tips.t: Freeze ripe bananas peeled and sliced: they blend in seconds.
Swap half the milk for a cold espresso for a mocha shake.

title: Berry and oat smoothie
intro: Soaked oats make it filling; frozen berries keep it icy cold.

steps.t: Pour the oat milk over the oats in the blender and let them soak for 5 minutes.
steps.label: Oats

steps.t: Add the frozen berries, banana, maple syrup and cinnamon.
Blend on high for 1–2 minutes, until no bits of oat remain.
Pour and drink right away, as it thickens on standing. Loosen with oat milk if needed.

tips.t: Pour any leftover into ice-pop moulds for a snack.
For a gluten-free version use certified gluten-free oats.

title: Persimmon cinnamon smoothie
intro: A very ripe persimmon is already a purée; just blend it with almond milk.

steps.t: Halve the persimmons, remove the calyx and scoop out the soft pulp with a spoon.
Put it in the blender with the almond milk, almond butter, cinnamon and lemon juice.
Add the ice and blend for 1 minute, until smooth and creamy.
Pour into glasses and finish with a pinch of cinnamon.

tips.t: The persimmon must be jelly-soft; a firm one tastes astringent.
A pinch each of ginger and nutmeg gives it a spiced-cake flavour.
